references.text: Psalm 7:1-2 warns against judging others, which reflects the message in Matthew 7:1 about not judging so that you will not be judged yourself.

Proverbs 30:12 speaks of people who are clean in their own eyes but have not been cleansed from their uncleanness, which can be seen in connection with the warning against judging others in Matthew 7:1.
Luke 6:37 gives a similar instruction not to judge, which directly corresponds with the message in Matthew 7:1.
James 4:11-12 warns against speaking evil of one another and judging one another, reflecting the principle of not judging as conveyed in Matthew 7:1.
Galatians 6:1 encourages restoring someone caught in sin with a spirit of gentleness, which can be viewed in light of avoiding judgmental attitudes mentioned in Matthew 7:1.
